title: Let's personalize your workspace
subtitle: A few quick questions so the assistant works the way you do. This is just for you — your teammates set up their own.

you.title: About you
you.description: Tell us who you are so the assistant can tailor its help.

goals.title: Your goals
goals.description: What do you want to get done? This personalizes your assistant.

honorific.label: How should Cluega address you?
honorific.hint: Just the word you like to be called by — change it any time.

goals.label: What do you want to focus on?

finishing.title: Personalizing your workspace
lines: Tailoring your assistant to how you work…

composer.title: Start here
composer.body: Type what you need — draft an ad, analyze performance, or ask anything. Pick a model and tools right from the composer.

skills.title: Add skills
skills.body: Attach skills to give the assistant extra expertise for a task. Your team's official skills and your own uploads live here.

sidebar.title: Your conversations
sidebar.body: Every chat is saved here. Jump back into past work or start something new anytime.

nav-cluega-ai.title: Cluega AI
nav-cluega-ai.body: The chat workspace, and where you already are. Every conversation is saved, reopens from the sidebar, and can be shared as a read-only link.

nav-capabilities.title: Capabilities
nav-capabilities.body: Connect the platforms Cluega works on, and deploy assistants into your chat channels. Start here — most other features need a connected account first.

nav-paid-ads.title: Paid Ads
nav-paid-ads.body: Read your connected ad accounts and build campaign structures. Account View shows what is running; Create Plan turns a goal into a plan.

nav-marketing-reports.title: Marketing Reports
nav-marketing-reports.body: Live dashboards and saved reports across every connected channel. Describe what you want to know and the board is built around the question.

nav-community.title: Community
nav-community.body: Reusable prompts, skills, agent templates and service plans. Take something that already works instead of starting from an empty box.

nav-insights.title: Insights
nav-insights.body: A browsable library of market assets and creators, for reference and for ideas before you commit budget.

nav-knowledge-base.title: Knowledge Base
nav-knowledge-base.body: The facts about your business that Cluega answers from — pricing, policies, product names, brand rules. Write them once and every later answer is built on them.

nav-new-project.title: Projects
nav-new-project.body: A project groups related tasks, and carries its own standing instructions and connected tools. Deleting one never deletes the work inside it.

nav-settings.title: Settings
nav-settings.body: Everything that applies across your work rather than to one task: account, credits and billing, team access, connectors, and scheduled runs.

integrations.title: Connect your platforms
integrations.body: This is App Authorization. Connect Meta, Google Ads, TikTok and the rest here — an account has to be connected before Cluega can read its data or act on it. You can come back and add more at any time.

suggestion-ads.title: Run ads from the chat box
suggestion-ads.body: This shortcut starts the paid-ads flow without leaving the conversation: pick a platform and an account, and Cluega takes it from there.

account-view.title: Account View
account-view.body: Everything running on your connected ad accounts in one place — spend, results and the metrics behind them. This is where you find out whether something is working before you change it.

create-ad-plan.title: Create Ad Plan
create-ad-plan.body: Describe the objective, budget and audience, and Cluega drafts the campaign structure for you to review. Nothing is published until you approve it.

create-ad-plan-platforms.title: Pick a launch platform
create-ad-plan-platforms.body: Each card opens the campaign flow for that platform and shows how many accounts you have authorized on it. Pick one and Cluega walks you through objective, creative and schedule.
